description: Classify the meeting type, run one workspace-context sweep, load the matching type-data file
Guided discovery against the type-data skeleton; offer research on unknowns
Generate the print-ready cheat sheet from the type skeleton and discovery
Presentation kickoff: resolve the runtime brand pack or run guided setup, inventory the materials already in hand, and write the run brief
Presentation sitting one of the narrative-lock capability: pin the audience, excavate friction to stakes to claim to transformation to doubt, and emit the decision-research and audience-intel briefs
Presentation audience-intel executor: run the intel briefs and return findings keyed to their return keys — briefs only, no interview dump and no design context
Presentation decision-research executor: walk themes, options, segments, implications, insights and connections as brief-sized chunks in one seat, never as a parallel corpus scrape
Presentation sitting two of the narrative-lock capability and GATE 1: agree the annotated spine with the owner and freeze it at the capability's completeness floor
Presentation fill research: one seat fanning per-beat content-facts and competitive-context probes in process; a falsified must-have claim FAILs to the leader instead of rewriting the lock
Presentation visual strategist stage: turn the locked narrative into the emphasis map, slide list, per-slide visual form and design handoff constraints — no palette, type, motif or grid
Presentation visual-reference extraction: run the design extraction capabilities the briefs name and build the reference set with real provenance
Presentation art direction: 2-3 distinct six-axis briefs within the brand-pack tokens and the Presentation profile constraints; the picked brief becomes the visual contract
Presentation GATE 2: present the slide list, the visual-communication plan and the art-direction options as one combined gate and record the owner's direction pick

Presentation deck build: agent-authored HTML slice by slice against the Presentation profile, the brand pack and the picked brief, plus the PDF from the converter print path; loop-back re-entries patch surgically

Presentation deterministic style check: the visual-check capability bound to its CLI, asserting source CSS, SVG and HTML against brand-pack tokens and the library Presentation profile. No owner contact
Presentation render inspection: a fresh-context reviewer reading actual screenshots against the picked brief, the visual-flaw-checklist and the copy tells — always before GATE 3

staffing-hints: a harness profile declaring headed: — this seat has the owner look at the RENDERED deck, and a headless sitting cannot show it; a hint for the staffer, never a binding
description: Presentation GATE 3: the owner reviews the rendered deck headed and accepts or bounces with notes, and the handover offer is recorded either way
Presentation handover package: assemble the accepted deck, the rationale document and the asset library into one offered-but-optional package
